contacts.label: Sunita Verma, Character.AI: Chief Technology Officer
contacts.linkedin_message:
Hi Sunita,

Saw Character.AI come up in our monitoring — a Reddit thread ("Ultimate Claude Code H4x0r: the four letter jailbreak") is discussing jailbreak/filter bypass techniques. Given your experience scaling AI safety at Google and now at Character.AI, you're likely already on this.

We help teams close the gap between "we have filters" and "we can prove we caught and blocked X in production." We've mapped 8 similar incidents (DPD chatbot, Microsoft Copilot EchoLeak, others) and built a compact checklist: self-harm escalation, medical boundaries, PII controls — runnable in one pass.

Happy to share what we've learned before the next thread blows up.
